title: Add analogdevicesinc_tmcl release team
author: jmacagba
body:
* Name of the new release team: analogdevicesinc_tmcl_team
* Release repositories to add:
  * [adi_tmcl](https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/tmcl_ros2)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/fa6c417d1bb9fe138bb3deb5d732633285b77af3/humble/distribution.yaml#L82C1-L91C23)

* Team members
  * [mmaralit-adi](https://github.com/mmaralit-adi)
  * [jmacagba](https://github.com/jmacagba)
  * [CAcarADI](https://github.com/CAcarADI)
  * [KApostolADI](https://github.com/KApostolADI)

comments.author: jmacagba
comments.body:
In relation to [#382](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/issues/382), the requested release repository for **adi_tmcl** will also be used for the ROS1 release.

**adi_tmcl** has been added to noetic distribution ([PR #39108](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/39108#pullrequestreview-1765323424)).

- adi_tmcl ROS1 [source link](https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/tmcl_ros)
- Noetic [rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/6f6275a00d232171989ead40681c4adef6bb8300/noetic/distribution.yaml#L78C1-L87C23)

comments.author: jmacagba
comments.body:
Thank you @cottsay !

Will all the team members listed have permission to change the default branch of the release repository?
If not, how can we change the default branch of https://github.com/ros2-gbp/adi_tmcl-release?

comments.author: cottsay
comments.body: I changed it to `master` for you, but keep in mind that Bloom doesn't care what the default branch is - it will always use `master` regardless.

comments.author: jmacagba
comments.body: Thanks again @cottsay , we wanted to have `master` as default branch anyway, so this is perfect.
